description: Token the app's functions use to read classic dashboards. Secret values are only readable by this app's functions, never by its users.

readConfigToken.description: Classic API token (dt0c01.…) with the ReadConfig scope; the Import tab lists and loads classic dashboards with it (GET /api/config/v1/dashboards).

readConfigTokenInfo.description: Who stored the token and when (set by the app).
